deviations.summary: A Linux geometry command referenced an unavailable Playwright tag instead of the already pinned local image ID. Docker began resolving/pulling layers; the command was interrupted immediately before completion, and no tagged image or test result was produced.
deviations.containment: All effective Linux runs used the pre-existing fixed local image ID sha256:caa6083aa787e4cfcaa661c73dd6244e4fa38d754dab0cc3b472156b277b0394. No candidate image was built, replaced, or pulled for use.
